name: Raymond Lifestyle Ltd
title: Raymond Lifestyle Ltd - 544240 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 15% to INR1,810 crore with EBITDA up 53%, but no numeric FY27 guidance; management calls FY27 a 'Year of Consolidation' with net 30-40 store adds and double-digit growth targets.

utilisation.quote: Our factory utilizations, which tradit ionally used to be between 80% -85%, have all gone above 90%.

capex.quote: So, the capex for the next year also would remain almost on the similar lines.

triggers.label: Factory utilisation 80-85% → above 90%
triggers.quote: Our factory utilizations, which tradit ionally used to be between 80% -85%, have all gone above 90%.

triggers.label: NWC days 87 → 77
triggers.quote: Net working capital improved significantly over last March and has come down by 10 days from 87 days to 77 days

triggers.label: Store net adds 30-40 in FY27
triggers.quote: we will continue to exit underperforming stores during the year and we think the net increase would be 30 to 40 this year.

triggers.label: Garmenting order book full for Q1
triggers.quote: my first quarter order books are completely full.

guidance.quote: We will look at this year once again as a double -digit growth in the year of consolidation.
Bottom-line should grow faster than top-line, so we will give you decent returns this year.
we are actually targeting less than 70 days of working capital
we think the net increase would be 30 to 40 this year.
So, the capex for the next year also would remain almost on the similar lines.

red_flags.label: Core apparel margin 7.8% excludes INR140 cr emerging businesses
red_flags.quote: the core four brands' revenue was INR1,667 crores with an EBITDA margin of 7.8%, which is without these new businesses.

red_flags.label: Q4 gross margin ex-subsidy ~44-45%, prior-year one-time INR53 cr subsidy
red_flags.quote: last year Q4 EBITDA of INR61 crores had a INR53 crores one-time subsidy from the government for our Amravati plant.

red_flags.label: Management history of unmet promises
red_flags.quote: Raymond has promised and always not delivered to that expectation.

evasions.quote: We are not giving a guidance at this stage
difficult for me to talk about 10-year and five-year turnover plans

evasions.topic: Garmenting/US-Europe shift rationale and store-level detail
evasions.quote: these guidances actually we do not provide
